item.title: Overview of Matthew Part 2 – Following the King to the Cross and the Crown 🟢 NEW
item.description: Adapted from insights by Ray C. Stedman and other biblical reflections. Opening Story # Imagine finally finding the king you have been waiting for. For years, people have spoken about him. They have longed for the day he would come, defeat his enemies, and establish a kingdom marked by justice, peace, and righteousness. When he finally arrives, he exceeds every expectation. His wisdom astonishes the crowds, his authority commands attention, and there is little doubt that he is the king everyone has been hoping for. Then, just as confidence in him reaches its highest point, he begins speaking about suffering. Instead of describing victory, he speaks of rejection. Instead of preparing for a coronation, he predicts his own death.
